## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] **Changeset added** via `pnpm changeset` (required if published code changed)
- [ ] README of the affected package is up to date (tool list, env vars, examples)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or live credentials in the diff
- [ ] For new servers: `servers/<name>/` follows the production-grade checklist in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Linked the related issue (Closes #..., Fixes #..., Refs #...)
